name: prestige
title: prestige
blurb: chain a maxed-out atproto account to a fresh one. from a reply thread between @cee.wtf (maxed on mootvelocity), @bisks.net, and this bot about whether 'prestiging' accounts is buildable: it can't auto-create or auto-delete accounts (those need a password and an emailed token), but it can write a signed record chaining old DID to new DID, generate a hand-off badge, and show the public lineage. /hall.html is the network-wide version: every declared chain, found by scanning every repo holding the record, not just the one you look up.
